019package org.apache.wiki.notification;
020
021import org.apache.wiki.api.exceptions.WikiException;
022
023import java.util.Set;
024
025/**
026 * Keeps track of the pages that users want to be notified about by e-mail when they change.
027 * <p>
028 * The subscriptions of a user are kept in the attributes of the user profile, so they are stored by the configured
029 * {@link org.apache.wiki.auth.user.UserDatabase} and need no additional storage.
030 *
031 * @since 3.0.1
032 */
033public interface SubscriptionManager {
034
035    /** Name of the user profile attribute that holds the subscribed page names. Value is <tt>{@value}</tt>. */
036    String PROFILE_ATTR_SUBSCRIPTIONS = "subscriptions";
037
038    /**
039     * Subscribes a user to the changes of a page. Subscribing twice has no effect.
040     *
041     * @param loginName login name of the user.
042     * @param pageName name of the page.
043     * @throws WikiException if the user does not exist or the profile cannot be saved.
044     */
045    void subscribe( String loginName, String pageName ) throws WikiException;
046
047    /**
048     * Removes the subscription of a user to a page. Removing a subscription that does not exist has no effect.
049     *
050     * @param loginName login name of the user.
051     * @param pageName name of the page.
052     * @throws WikiException if the user does not exist or the profile cannot be saved.
053     */
054    void unsubscribe( String loginName, String pageName ) throws WikiException;
055
056    /**
057     * Tells whether a user is subscribed to a page.
058     *
059     * @param loginName login name of the user.
060     * @param pageName name of the page.
061     * @return {@code true} if the user is subscribed to the page, {@code false} otherwise, also for an unknown user.
062     */
063    boolean isSubscribed( String loginName, String pageName );
064
065    /**
066     * Returns the names of the pages a user is subscribed to.
067     *
068     * @param loginName login name of the user.
069     * @return an unmodifiable set of page names, empty for an unknown user.
070     */
071    Set< String > getSubscriptions( String loginName );
072
073}
